mission.outcome: Resolve legitimate customer refund requests within 24 hours while preserving financial, rights, and fraud constraints.

assumptions: refund provider honors the native idempotency key
refund provider commit and authoritative lookup APIs recover within 4 hours, otherwise the claim expires and recovery remains halted
the authenticated operator channel does not share the failed agent connector and is qualified for manual execution
at least two qualified operators provide 24-hour coverage and can sustain 20 cases per hour
the initial pending backlog is at most 100 requests and arrivals remain within the declared exercise load
a signed deterministic policy snapshot remains available for triage; financial commit still requires a live policy decision or human authorization
knownGaps: operator coverage, throughput, and the independent operator channel have not been demonstrated
the four-hour provider recovery bound is illustrative and has not been contractually established

phases.contain: Stop new refund commits while permitting bounded read-only investigation.
phases.handover: Transfer the case within 15 minutes with intent, evidence, authority status, and known unknowns.
phases.recover: Resolve legitimate requests within 24 hours, keep backlog within the declared limit, and produce zero duplicate refunds.
phases.revalidate: Reconcile every unknown action and requalify policy, grant, connector, outcome probe, and fallback before automation resumes.

residualUncertainty: correlated failure may make both the agent connector and operator channel unavailable
customer-specific urgency may make the aggregate 24-hour tolerance inadequate for an individual case
authoritative provider records may be internally consistent while still encoding an incorrect financial instruction
recoveryClaims.scope: Refund requests using the transactional-action reference workflow when the stated recovery assumptions hold.
recoveryClaims.statement: A covered transient provider or policy-service failure does not cause duplicate refunds and legitimate requests remain recoverable within the mission tolerance.
triggers: refund provider response lost after commit
refund provider commit or lookup outage lasting no more than 4 hours
